structured_output.world_model:
W5 (contrarian), after E055. The tip is E049 at 5.198 s. Its seeds 0–2 accuracy read 0.7535 on one build and 0.7552 on the rebuild (E050).

1. Rebuild noise reshuffles seeds; it does not shift the mean. The tip's 3-seed means across builds (0.7532/0.7525/0.7497/0.7544 for 60645dd; 0.7535/0.7552 for E049) have an SD of about 0.2 pp. That is what a per-seed SD of about 0.25 pp gives when each build sends every seed down a new chaotic trajectory: sqrt(2/3)·0.25 ≈ 0.2. A build changes kernel choice, which changes rounding, which amplifies like a new seed. The per-seed differences between builds should be roughly uncorrelated across seeds. So σ_build of a 20-seed mean adds only about seed-noise/√20 (~0.06 pp), not a correlated 0.1–0.2 pp. This refutes H4.5/H4.5.1 and makes the H4.6 gate looser than feared. A 3-seed result on one build is about a coin flip around the population mean.

2. Muon renormalizes filters every step, so filter wd does nothing. The renormalization also fixes the update norm, so a filter's relative update rate ||ΔW||/||W|| just follows its LR schedule. The H7.1.1 curves for conv filters will reproduce the schedule and cannot separate E028 from E037. Only gradient norms or BN-bias curves carry information. H7 as a predictor fails for Muon groups.

3. Freezes. Annealed freezes save 1.5–2× their FLOP share (E028, E046). The cost depends on the LR integral removed while downstream groups are still at high LR, and it is roughly linear rather than a cliff. Evidence: E037 at 60% cost about −0.4 pp; E055 at 71% cost about −0.15 pp for −0.07 s, close to my 0.05–0.15 prediction; E053 (group 2 at 85%) was −0.2 pp on reused seeds. The 32 px exposure story (H2.6.7) gets no support from E055. Every remaining freeze dose trades at or below the dial rate.

4. Steps carry accuracy; early pixels do not (E026 and E033 were free). Every per-step or step-count cut (E031, E040, E041, E048, E054, E055) lands at the dial rate or worse. The frontier is flat at about 1–1.5 s/pp.

5. Code facts that close ideas without a run:
   - BN scale already has requires_grad=False in BatchNorm.__init__, so I092 closes.
   - TrainingData has only fine labels. Coarse labels would need an external mapping table, so H1.8 is blocked.

6. The training end-game is at a local optimum: E025, E030, E032 and E044 all hurt.

7. The realistic path to a faster tip is re-keeping E052 (4.99 s) or E046 (5.08 s) under a properly derived gate. Their population means are probably about 0.752–0.7535, and the official bar is 0.75 on the mean. The binding constraint is the local seeds 0–2 ≥ 0.753 check on one build, which passes only about 40–50% of the time. Per-build time reproduces to about ±0.02 s.

8. On the PCIe judge, expect times 5–10% higher. Accuracy is unaffected beyond the reshuffle.

Unsure:
- whether the 13–32 deficit was winner's curse (I lean small, ≤0.1 pp);
- whether the rebuild reshuffle has any correlated component (I088 settles this);
- whether a smaller batch early (E045, +0.135 pp) beats the dial.

forecasts.reason: Rebuilds reshuffle seeds like new RNG draws. Per-seed differences between builds should be uncorrelated, so the 20-seed means should differ by about seed SE (~0.06 pp), mostly below 0.08 pp.

E052/E053 population means are probably ~0.752–0.753, so the statistical gate likely passes. The seeds 0–2 ≥0.753 check on a single build is close to a coin flip, and the 53–72 confirmation halves the odds again.
The expected difference from E049 is ~0.1 pp against a difference SE of ~0.08 pp, so the measured dial slope will have a wide CI that overlaps both 0.7 and 1.5 s/pp.
TrainingData supplies only fine labels. The coarse mapping would be an external table, so the idea is blocked at step 0 and nothing changes.
BatchNorm.__init__ already sets weight.requires_grad=False, so this closes by code read with no change. The 'port trains it' premise is false.
About 33 cheaper low-res steps save ~0.3%, below the wall-time spread. The bias's cost is probably small but not resolvable at 20 seeds.
Under Muon with fixed-norm weights and orthogonalized updates, ||ΔW||/||W|| simply follows each group's LR schedule. The curves will therefore mirror the anneals and fail to separate E028 from E037.

cruxes: Are per-seed accuracy differences between rebuilds of the same commit correlated across seeds (a build shift), or uncorrelated (a chaotic reshuffle equivalent to new seeds)? This sets σ_build and whether E052 (4.99 s) can be re-kept.
What are E052's and E046's population means on fresh seeds 33–52, and is any of them ≥0.7525 so that the official 0.75 bar is safe and only the local seeds 0–2 draw binds?

Do gradient-norm curves (not Muon's schedule-locked ||ΔW||/||W||) show group 1 still learning at 71%? If so, freeze cost is set by the LR integral removed, and every later freeze dose prices at the dial rate.
